experiments.scope: Selected target sha256-r31-prefix-v1. One real matched chaining value (published first block M0) with published W0..W12; each organizer seed drives complete Step 3 (V16 scan, W14, W18, E13, E15). Returns a NEW second-block pair, not the published ASIACRYPT pair.
experiments.hypothesis: Given a matched chaining value satisfying Table 6 through step 12, Step 3 returns distinct ordinary collisions of the complete padded target on every trial (fresh M1/M1', not the published pair).
